test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement and conclusion for pictorial drawing are given below. Determine the logical relationship between them.

Statement: Pictorial drawings are three-dimensional and provide a visual representation of an object.

Conclusion: Therefore, pictorial drawings are useful for describing the shape of a piece part or component.

options.text: The conclusion is partially supported by the statemet.
The conclusion logically follows from the statement.
The conclusion is unrelated to the statement.
The conclusion does not logically follow from the statement.

solution:
The correct answer is __The conclusion logically follows from the statement__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pictorial drawings__ are three-dimensional and provide a visual representation of an object.
 
• They help in understanding the shape and structure of a piece part or component visually.
 
• The conclusion logically aligns with the statement as pictorial drawings are useful for describing the shape of objects.
 
• The statement establishes the functionality and purpose of pictorial drawings, which directly supports the conclusion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Pictorial Drawings:**

 
 
• Pictorial drawings are widely used in engineering and design to visualize objects.
 
• They provide a clear and accurate representation of components for better understanding and communication.
 
 
 
• **Types of Pictorial Drawings:**
 
 
• Isometric drawings: Show equal dimensions along three axes.
 
• Perspective drawings: Create a realistic view by using vanishing points.
 
• Oblique drawings: Display objects with one face parallel to the viewing plane.
